bootstrap.cell_mean_note: cell means under 'cell_summaries' are taken over each cell's own observed sequences, so a difference of two cell means need not equal the corresponding contrast when some cell has missing observations; the contrast is the complete-case quantity and is authoritative
bootstrap.covariance_note: each contrast is formed per sequence first and then resampled, so main effects and the interaction carry the correct covariance between the four cells; combining separately bootstrapped pairwise reports would not
bootstrap.missing_value_rule: a contrast column is built by arithmetic over the cells it needs, so NaN propagation restricts it to the complete-case subset of exactly those cells; excluded via np.nanmean
bootstrap.shared_across: all four cells, all contrasts and all metrics

a00_minus_a00.null_hypothesis: trivially true; a non-zero value here means the machinery is broken
a00_minus_a00.positive_means: nothing: this is the self-control row and must be exactly 0.0 with a degenerate interval [0.0, 0.0]

a01_minus_a00.null_hypothesis: detach has no effect while hinge is held at level 0
a01_minus_a00.positive_means: cell a01 (hinge=0, detach=1) reports a LARGER value than the a00 reference cell

a10_minus_a00.null_hypothesis: hinge has no effect while detach is held at level 0
a10_minus_a00.positive_means: cell a10 (hinge=1, detach=0) reports a LARGER value than the a00 reference cell

a11_minus_a00.null_hypothesis: the two factors together have no combined effect
a11_minus_a00.positive_means: cell a11 (both factors at level 1) reports a LARGER value than the a00 reference cell

a11_minus_a01.null_hypothesis: hinge has no effect while detach is held at level 1
a11_minus_a01.positive_means: cell a11 reports a LARGER value than cell a01, i.e. turning hinge on raises the metric while detach is held at level 1

a11_minus_a10.null_hypothesis: detach has no effect while hinge is held at level 1
a11_minus_a10.positive_means: cell a11 reports a LARGER value than cell a10, i.e. turning detach on raises the metric while hinge is held at level 1

interaction_hinge_x_detach.null_hypothesis: the two factors are additive: the effect of hinge is the same at both levels of detach
interaction_hinge_x_detach.positive_means: the effect of hinge is MORE POSITIVE when detach is on than when it is off; equivalently the effect of detach is more positive when hinge is on

main_effect_detach.null_hypothesis: detach has no average effect across the levels of hinge
main_effect_detach.positive_means: averaged over both levels of hinge, turning detach on RAISES the metric

main_effect_hinge.null_hypothesis: hinge has no average effect across the levels of detach
main_effect_hinge.positive_means: averaged over both levels of detach, turning hinge on RAISES the metric

design.group_note: a contrast is listed once under 'contrasts' and may appear in two groups; a10_minus_a00 and a01_minus_a00 are both simple effects against a00 and components of a main effect

interaction_identity_check.claim: the two algebraic forms of the interaction are the same linear functional of the four cells and must agree to floating-point tolerance; a disagreement means a cell or a sign is wrong in this implementation
interaction_identity_check.tolerance_rule: atol 1e-12 + rtol 1e-12 * max |cell value| for that metric

sign_convention.direction: positive means the first-named side of the stated form is LARGER; each contrast repeats this in its own 'positive_means' field
sign_convention.polarity_note: this tool does not encode metric polarity, so 'larger' is not 'better': for penetration and error metrics (hand_pen_loss_omomo, human_pen_loss_infbagel, mpjpe, end_obj_trans_err) lower is better, for contact metrics (contact_f1, contact_recall) higher is better
sign_convention.significance_rule: 'crosses_zero' is false exactly when the interval strictly excludes zero; a degenerate interval at [0.0, 0.0] touches zero and is therefore reported as crossing it
sign_convention.units: every reported quantity is a difference in the metric's own units, never a ratio or a percentage
